reputation.summary: A pro-audio and engineering classic rather than a rolling favourite. PMI and ADI aimed it at professional audio (±10 V into 600 Ω) with RIAA, NAB tape-head and mic preamp circuits. A 1990s audio FAQ calls it 'very well received' for phono, head-amp and mic preamps; Douglas Self covers it in 'The Design of Active Crossovers'. No ASR measurements verified.
typical_uses: Low-noise gain from low source impedance (<1–3 kΩ)
caveats: OP37 is stable only at gain ≥5; an unplugged mic input (100% feedback) can oscillate.
Bias-current cancellation raises current noise: above about 3 kΩ source, the OP07 is quieter at low frequencies.
OP27's 2.8 V/µs and 8 MHz cause RIAA errors above 40 dB gain; best linearity below ±10 mA output.
Input diodes conduct above 0.7 V differential; use Rf ≥ 500 Ω in fast unity-gain buffers.
ADI, ADI/LTC and TI sell it with different grade sets; specs and sound may differ by vendor.

counterfeit_notes: No verified OP27/OP37 counterfeit reports. PMI, ADI, LTC and TI logos are all legitimate. OPA27/OPA37 are different parts. Distrust cheap A-grade CERDIP or TO-99 offers; check ≈3 mA at ±15 V and a ≈3 nV/√Hz noise floor.

silicon_changes.summary: TI makes its own OP27A/OP27C (SLOS100, Rev. E Feb 2010) and an OP37 under PMI/ADI's numbers. Whether TI's die is its own or licensed is undocumented. Headline noise matches ADI (3 nV/√Hz, 2.7 Hz corner). TI's OP27C differs from the old PMI OP27C.
silicon_changes.identification: TI logo and ordering codes; datasheet SLOS100. TI grades A and C only; ADI grades A/E/G.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same pinout, sockets and headline specs; differences only in unspecified parameters.
silicon_changes.verification: Based on TI and ADI datasheets; not separately rechecked.

silicon_changes.when: late 1980s on; both at ADI since 2017
silicon_changes.summary: Two OP27 lines now sit under ADI: the PMI-heritage OP27 and the Linear Technology OP27 (op27-ltc.html). Whether the LTC die is an independent design is unconfirmed.
silicon_changes.identification: LTC logo; ADI's separate OP27-LTC page; LTC A/C/E/G grade set versus ADI A/E/G.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: pin-compatible, same grade names; unspecified parameters may differ.
silicon_changes.verification: Based on ADI product page and LTC datasheet mirrors; not separately rechecked.

silicon_changes.summary: Rev. F added Pb-free lead-finish versions. No documented die change; one spec table covers leaded and Pb-free parts.
silicon_changes.identification: Trailing Z after P or S ('Z = Pb-free part'); not the CERDIP Z in OP27AZ/EZ/GZ.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same specs and pinout; only lead finish differs.
silicon_changes.verification: Backed by the datasheet revision history.
